Cycling.title: In the heart of cycling country.
Cycling.intro: La Casilla sits in the Vall d’en Bas, right in the volcanic landscape of the Garrotxa — one of Catalonia’s classic cycling regions. Real climbs, quiet valley roads and traffic-free greenways all start from your doorstep.
Cycling.braconsBody: A real mountain pass (1,132 m) linking the valley to Osona — a proper test for anyone chasing elevation.
Cycling.valleyBody: Quiet, well-surfaced roads through farmland and volcanic cones — an easy warm-up, or a relaxed day for mixed-ability groups.
Cycling.greenwayBody: Nearly 60 km of flat, traffic-free path — plus Olot itself, the comarca’s hub, with bike shops and services.

NextStep.title: The house, the crew and the bikes.
NextStep.body: A starting point for riding through the region, and a private space to rest, cook and unwind together at the end of each day.
